listingTitle: MyGift Modern Black Mail Holder Organizer with Cutout MAIL Lettering Design
listingLines: Modern Cutout MAIL Design – Features a sleek black metal construction with a bold cutout “MAIL” label, adding a contemporary touch to any home office, entryway, or desk space.
Compact Yet Spacious Storage – Provides ample room for sorting and storing envelopes, letters, bills, postcards, and small documents while keeping countertops tidy and clutter-free.
Durable Metal Construction – Made from sturdy black metal for long-lasting use, maintaining its shape and style even with everyday handling.
Versatile Desktop or Countertop Use – Ideal for organizing mail at home, in the office, or in reception areas, offering a clean and efficient solution for daily document management.
Approximate Dimensions: 6.0 L x 2.2 W x 3.8 H (in inches)
